audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read Annie while content win[0..6] read Katarina on every row and every phases[N].why describes Katarina winning the stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Katarina x7 and the content prose says the same thing throughout: Annie is a 625-range immobile mage whose only real threat is a stun she has to arm with four casts.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved to Katarina, matching win[0..6] and the whys.

audit.why: The four spikes are placed on real timings and Annie's are stack-gated rather than level-gated, which spikes[0] and spikes[2] already state. Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100s, so a spent ult is a long window.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit and gave no sequencing at all (the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'). Nothing on the page said that Pyromania's stun and Summon: Tibbers both cancel Death Lotus mid-channel — the single most important interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Katarina's R is flagged 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Annie carries two hardCC sources: Pyromania (next offensive spell stuns after 4 casts) and Summon: Tibbers. Her restock rate is fast because Disintegrate is 4s and Incinerate 7s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Pyromania's 4-cast arming plus Q 4s / W 7s and Tibbers 130s at rank 1 with a wait-then-commit line; dontsFull[2].d states the double cancel.

edits.before: - Annie Summon: Tibbers: matchup-defining — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Shunpo (second use) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Pyromania: 4 spell casts to arm; Disintegrate is 4s and Incinerate 7s, so she restocks fast — count from her last stun. - Summon: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1; wait it out before you commit. - E Shunpo's second cast is the exit, R is the finisher.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by counting to four — Annie is a 625-range immobile mage the moment Pyromania is spent, and that is your window.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: Enter second: let her spend the stun and Tibbers on your frontline, then Shunpo the reset chain onto her 625-range body.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave in Incinerate range — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
